correctness.rationale: For the specified one-coordinate 2-spinor block H=m σ_z⊗I+σ_x⊗A on Z/p^ℓZ, radiality forces every Fourier character of conductor p^ℓ (comprising fraction (p−1)/p of the Fourier modes) to share a common eigenvalue and hence identical pure evolved spinor. The reduced qubit density is w|φ〉〈φ|+(1−w)τ, w=1−1/p≥1/2. Rayleigh quotient gives λ_max≥w and the monotonicity of binary entropy on [1/2,1] yields S(t)≤h₂(1/p) for arbitrary mass/time/radial weights. At m=0, direct σ_x diagonalization gives S=h₂((1+|Fℓ(t)|)/2), and triangle equality gives the stated necessary-and-sufficient phase alignment condition. For the explicitly constructed strictly positive hopping kernel, the radial generator has Fourier eigenvalues a_0=0, a_j=−2g for 1≤j<ℓ and a_ℓ=−3g; at t=π/(2g), low phases align opposite high, giving exact saturation at each depth; for fixed mass>0 the same is a supremum as g→∞. Independent matrix Fourier/entropy calculations for primes 2,3,5 at multiple depths matched h₂(1/p). These tests supplement the exact representation proof.
